diagnoses.root_cause: The site example.com is a placeholder page with no booking services, locations, or time‑slot elements, so the agent cannot find any interactive controls to proceed.
diagnoses.fix:
Replace the placeholder content with a functional booking interface. For example, add a form with labeled controls:

```html
<form id="booking-form">
  <label for="service">Service:</label>
  <select id="service" name="service">
    <option value="consultation">Consultation</option>
    <option value="repair">Repair</option>
  </select>
  <label for="location">Location:</label>
  <input type="text" id="location" name="location" placeholder="Enter location" required>
  <label for="slot">Time Slot:</label>
  <input type="datetime-local" id="slot" name="slot" required>
  <button type="submit">Book Now</button>
</form>
```
Ensure each control has an associated `<label>` for accessibility and that the form is reachable via the site’s navigation.
